tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a smooth, monotone-concave response over a narrow u_now range, but the competing saturation/power-law explanations remain plausible. An open-branch discriminating probe is the most direct low-cost way to resolve that ambiguity; the target horizon matches the pilot horizon, so a longer-horizon probe is not indicated.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a Haldane or Cobb–Douglas model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five measurements vary only u_now; s_grad is nearly fixed and correlated input effects are not identified. The concave trend alone cannot distinguish these families reliably.
Higher-resolution sampling along the same narrow branch is less useful than a probe that opens a discriminating input regime.
It is irrelevant to resolving the observed model ambiguity.
